scene_jp: <ruby>東京駅<rt>とうきょうえき</rt></ruby>の<ruby>中央<rt>ちゅうおう</rt></ruby>コンコースは、いつもより<ruby>静<rt>しず</rt></ruby>かだった。<ruby>夕方<rt>ゆうがた</rt></ruby>の<ruby>光<rt>ひかり</rt></ruby>が<ruby>高<rt>たか</rt></ruby>い<ruby>天井<rt>てんじょう</rt></ruby>から<ruby>差<rt>さ</rt></ruby>し<ruby>込<rt>こ</rt></ruby>んで、<ruby>床<rt>ゆか</rt></ruby>に<ruby>長<rt>なが</rt></ruby>い<ruby>影<rt>かげ</rt></ruby>を<ruby>作<rt>つく</rt></ruby>っていた。ふと<ruby>気<rt>き</rt></ruby>がつくと、<ruby>足元<rt>あしもと</rt></ruby>に<ruby>小<rt>ちい</rt></ruby>さな<ruby>封筒<rt>ふうとう</rt></ruby>が<ruby>落<rt>お</rt></ruby>ちている。<ruby>封筒<rt>ふうとう</rt></ruby>を<ruby>拾<rt>ひろ</rt></ruby>い上げると、そこには<ruby>見覚<rt>みおぼ</rt></ruby>えのない<ruby>字<rt>じ</rt></ruby>で「テストへ」と<ruby>書<rt>か</rt></ruby>いてあった。<ruby>近<rt>ちか</rt></ruby>くに<ruby>立<rt>た</rt></ruby>っていた<ruby>老人<rt>ろうじん</rt></ruby>が、こちらを<ruby>見<rt>み</rt></ruby>て<ruby>静<rt>しず</rt></ruby>かに<ruby>言<rt>い</rt></ruby>った。「……<ruby>来<rt>き</rt></ruby>たか、テスト。<ruby>開<rt>あ</rt></ruby>けてはいけないよ、まだ。」
scene_translation: The central concourse of Tokyo Station was quieter than usual. Evening light poured down from the high ceiling, casting long shadows across the floor. Then you noticed it — a small envelope lying at your feet. When you picked it up, written in an unfamiliar hand were the words: 'To Tesuto.' Nearby, an old man who had been standing watching you said quietly, '...So you've come, Tesuto. You mustn't open it. Not yet.'
grammar_note: 【〜てはいけない】means 'must not / you shouldn't.' The old man says 開けてはいけないよ — 'you must not open it.' This is a prohibition. Note his speech style: short, quiet sentences with よ at the end — the register of someone older and serious, neither rude nor formal.

mystery_memo: The sealed envelope addressed to 'Tesuto' by name is the central mystery hook — someone knew the player was arriving at Tokyo Station. The old man also knows the player's name and warned them not to open it yet, suggesting the timing matters. Relationship with old man: NEUTRAL/MYSTERIOUS — he is watchful but not threatening. The envelope is a key item; its contents are unknown. The old man's identity and connection to the player must be revealed gradually across Act 1-2.
